svg.text: tb_mpdda_noise: output noise of d2s_mpdda, tt 27 C, load 1 kOhm to vref || 100 pF
DUT and bias from the schematics in this directory; code block = the deck's .lib/.param/.save lines and its .control section
* integrated noise first (plots noise1 = spectrum, noise2 = total), then two spot values
* a one-point noise run makes only a spectrum plot: noise3 (1 kHz), noise4 (100 kHz)
